report.explanation: All checkout observations returned HTTP 200 with low latency (62-78ms) except one 344ms outlier; traces show successful downstream calls and healthy DB pool (size 1, idle 1). No error, saturation, or leak signal supports any taxonomy cause. Deployment record only shows gateway 1.0.0 baseline. Insufficient evidence to establish a bounded root cause; handing off.
missing_evidence: Latency baseline/SLO for /v1/checkout to judge whether 344ms outlier is anomalous

DB pool utilization and wait metrics under load to rule out db-pool-exhaustion
Redis latency/timeout metrics to rule out redis-timeout
Sustained memory-retention time series to rule out memory-leak
